stem:
Disha's family in Ahmedabad dries red chillies on the terrace and also has a small solar panel on the roof.

Which statement about these uses of the Sun is correct?

options.text: A solar cooker on the terrace cooks equally well in bright sunlight and in complete darkness.
With everything else unchanged, the solar panel produces more electricity when less sunlight reaches it.
Drying chillies uses heat from the Sun, and the panel needs sunlight to make electricity; without sunlight those uses weaken or stop.
Solar cookers work by producing electricity for a stove.

teacher.key_rationale: Direct Sun heat dries food; solar panels need sunlight to make electricity. A drops the sunlight condition; B reverses sunlight–output link; D confuses solar cooking with electricity generation.
